c: Choose My Requests at the top of Employee Center.
say: In Employee Center, choose My Requests at the top of the page.

c: Open it to see its state, urgency and who is working on it.
say: Open your incident to see its state, its urgency, and who is working on it.

c: Write in the Activity tab and press Send, or reply to any email about it.
say: To add information, write in the activity tab and press send, or reply to any email about it.

c: When the team writes, you get a Comment added email.
say: When the team writes to you, you get an email with their message.

c: On Hold means they wait for you. Your reply puts it back to In Progress.
say: On hold means the team is waiting for you. Your reply puts it back in progress.
Fixed it yourself? Press resolve on the incident's page.
